content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment platforms often impose high fees and stringent requirements that restrict access for many digital creators. For instance, Gumroad charges a hefty 10% on every sale, which can rapidly diminish your profits. In contrast, using NOWPayments only incurs a minimal 0.5% fee. By deploying your own digital commerce infrastructure, you gain complete control over your sales, eliminate dependency on third-party platforms, and retain more revenue, allowing you to focus on growing your business.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need a few essential components. First, secure a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which is free and reliable. Next, you'll need backend logic, which can be implemented using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. For product storage, you can leverage Supabase or Google Sheets. Lastly, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. These tools will enable automated payment verification and file delivery, ensuring a smooth transaction experience for your customers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish a functional payment and delivery pipeline, begin by setting up your NOWPayments account. Configure your payment options to accept multiple cryptocurrencies, ensuring you cater to a broader audience. Next, configure your backend logic to handle payment confirmations and trigger automated file delivery upon successful transactions. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script will facilitate this process, allowing you to streamline order fulfillment efficiently. With these systems in place, you can ensure that your customers receive their digital products instantly after payment.
Eliminate high platform fees with your own infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it's time to go live. Publish your digital store on your chosen hosting platform and test your payment processing to ensure everything functions as expected. Make a test purchase to verify the entire flow from payment to product delivery. This step is crucial for identifying any potential issues before you start attracting customers. Once confirmed, you can confidently promote your digital products and begin processing transactions, knowing that your infrastructure is robust and reliable.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your first transactions, consider strategies for scaling your operations. Monitor customer feedback and adapt your product offerings to meet demand. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates that can help you expand your product range and improve your store's functionality. As your sales grow, ensure that your infrastructure can handle increased traffic and transactions without compromising performance. Regularly review and optimize your systems to maintain a seamless customer experience.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack. By deploying your own infrastructure using tools like NOWPayments for crypto payments, you bypass traditional platform fees entirely, retaining more profit from your sales. This approach allows you to maintain full control over your business operations.
Retain more profits by using NOWPayments for transactions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by creating your own online store with the right infrastructure. This allows you to avoid the high fees associated with platforms like Gumroad and Payhip.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing flexibility for your customers. This extensive range ensures that you can cater to a global audience.
Is there a way to automate file delivery after payment?

Yes, you can automate file delivery using backend logic implemented through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This ensures that customers receive their purchases instantly after payment confirmation.
